The gating problem is price, not existence: the stock has roughly doubled off the 52-week low and trades at its 52-week high with sell-side targets (~$17 average, Citizens $19) at or below spot, so the risk/reward on a ~25% take-private premium against a no-deal round-trip toward the 200dma is roughly 1:1. Downgraded from triage ACTIVE/7 to WATCH/5.5 on the re-rating and G1/G3 failure. Analytical screening output only, not investment advice.
